title: See Maybe Happy Ending on Broadway
description: In a future Seoul, two obsolete helper robots meet in a quiet apartment building and begin an unlikely friendship. Maybe Happy Ending uses music, humor, and inventive stagecraft to make their small discoveries feel enormous. Take a seat at the Belasco Theatre and let the story build from everyday curiosity into something tender and surprising.
teaser: Meet two retired robots in an intimate Broadway musical.
goodToKnow: Check the show’s current run and ticket availability before planning a trip around it.
whyItMightDelightYou: Its small-scale story makes room for affection, loneliness, and the courage to connect.
